verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Genie Code as a chat-driven assistant that runs agentic tasks in the workspace. It generates and runs code, builds pipelines and AI/BI dashboards, and debugs errors, including as an autonomous agent that asks for approval before using tools. Genie and Genie One add natural-language data questions and natural-language dashboard creation, including on mobile. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well these natural-language commands work, and evidence that natural language extends to administrative operations such as compute, permissions and budgets.
